caption: The drawing shows a square quilt pattern with a botanical theme, consisting mainly of leaf shapes and a central geometric motif. The main square is bordered by a green vine that curves along the top and left sides, bearing small green leaves and a few red, oval-shaped leaves. Within the square, four stems radiate diagonally outward from a central red square, each stem also depicted in green and branching out into several smaller green leaves. Around the outer parts of the square, red oval leaves form ring-like clusters, each ring composed of four red leaves. The background is filled with a subtle diagonal crosshatch pattern in light gray or beige. Below and to the right of the main composition, there is a smaller square detail showing a close-up of three red leaves attached to a green stem, with the same crosshatch background. The name "Charles Roadman" is written in small letters on the left below the main pattern. The predominant colors in the drawing are red, green, and light beige.
title: Quilt (Red and Green Leaves)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
